t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They attempted a lot of theories but there seemed to be little correlation in what they did although they did seem to think that it may correlate to the previous colour of the basket and to pick the gnome closest to that colour in the next round

vb_textbox.text: I found that certain colours were always paired with each other and generally one was better than the other, I saw that small gnomes were usually better than large so pick small if given a choice. The colour combinations I saw that I noticed any pattern with was Red>Orange and Purple>Brown and I suspect that Yellow>Pink and Green>Blue although im less certain on those ones.
